title: Unit Event — The Way I Played That Day — Episode2 What I Want To Do

meta.Event: The Way I Played That Day
meta.Episode: Episode2 — What I Want To Do
meta.Event Outline: Kanade continues to write songs in the hope of saving Mafuyu. When her grandmother calls to suggest that she think more about herself and her own future, her thoughts turn toward the past.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <But I believe it's about time for you to start thinking more seriously about your own future.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <Yes. For starters, what are you going to do after you graduate? You need to begin planning for that.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <That's why I'd like to hear what you think, Kanade. What would you like to do...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I've never given it much thought before.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I've been investing all of my time into composing songs that could save people...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I don't really know what I want to do...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I have to keep composing...
Anything other than that seems...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You have school tomorrow, don't you, Mafuyu? It's getting late, so why don't you go first?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh, K.
About what your envisioning for this song...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <About this song... Actually, is everything okay? It seems like you've been having trouble concentrating today.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<My grandma called me today.
She told me that I should probably start thinking about what I want to do after I graduate...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. I'm not sure what I'm going to do since I've been spending all my time composing music...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mean, who actually knows what they want to do in the future?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I haven't even had time to give my own future any serious thought...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. I want to keep drawing, but I don't know what to do about art school and stuff...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, right. Art schools are super competitive, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But it'd be great if you got into a school where you can further pursue art since you're so passionate about it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <While we're on the subject, K, is there anything you want to do after you graduate?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Honestly, I kind of want to just keep composing like I've always been...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<No, that's not what I'm talking about.
I'm trying to ask you if...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, are you asking what she “wants” to do instead of what she feels that she “has” to do...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah! Just like how Enanan wants to keep drawing. Isn't there something like that that really drives you?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I have to keep composing.
Nothing else really drives me the same way...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Oh, sorry...
I still can't think of anything else...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <To be fair, this is your life we're talking about. You don't want to make any hasty decisions.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I still don't even know what I'm gonna do yet, so I think you should take your time...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Not gonna lie, I'm a little relieved...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mean, K, you're always working really hard for the sake of others...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You compose songs in the hopes that you'll save someone. Yuki, for example... You've even done a lot for us.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Which is why I'm glad that you're getting a chance to think about yourself for a change...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I see what you mean.
K does usually put others before herself.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Exactly.
I really admire that. I have a huge amount of respect for you...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But I also think you should take more time to do the things that you want, K. The things you think are fun.>
